description: React component for rendering an interactive mind map canvas. It handles layout computation, zooming, panning, and node/edge rendering within an SVG, supporting user interactions such as node selection, zooming, and dragging.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates node positions in a radial-like layout centered on a specified node.

methods.name: getNodeColor
methods.description: Determines the fill color of a node based on its state.

methods.name: getNodeStroke
methods.description: Determines the stroke color of a node based on its state.
